notes:
Settings > General > View onboarding again opens a sample-only walkthrough. You can try provider, genre, sports and team choices and exit with your real setup intact.

Poster tiles can show a matching cached backdrop while a portrait loads, then switch to the portrait. Existing light borders on team logos, including the Raiders shield, are preserved. Dark transparent marks retain the outline treatment.

Tested on Android phone and TV emulators. Artwork availability depends on the provider and metadata source.
